status: Preliminary physical development candidate — not for fabrication or passenger operation
scope: One custom two-axle passenger coach truck with front accessible body interface, plus a separate plain rear/standard-coach body interface. Locomotive trucks and drivetrain are excluded.

source_basis.coach_geometry: J1a retained geometry at source 0f689682ddc40c6024e9d888625d22dcdf84170a; source records retained in the site

descriptions: Separate frame webs, caps, crossbeam walls/diaphragms and representative weld joints
Four guided journal boxes with wear pads, countersunk fasteners, maintenance covers, labyrinth/seal clearances and locating/floating bearing arrangements
Eight custom coils, centering pilots, seats, internal cores, capture rods/washers and drop keepers
Four damper procurement envelopes with real clevises, eye bolts, washers and nuts
Annular spherical center bearing, separate retained kingpin, sleeves, body bolts, supported service hatches and compliant sidebearer cartridges
Axle-riding outboard brake carriers, paired bearings, articulated torque links, frame anchor boxes and removable hub blanks

support_contract.sidebearer_law_status: Zero running gap and 1000 N/mm are development targets. Twenty millimetres compression is a procurement target, not qualified useful stroke.

reserved_drum_space.status: Design allocation; actual OEM part dimensions must fit this bounded envelope

verification.scope: Exact nominal sampled geometry only. No tolerance-stack, continuous swept envelope, dynamic, structural, fatigue, braking or operating acceptance is inferred. Simultaneous 2° roll plus 2° pitch is outside the 2° resultant cone and has known interference.
